scope: One production assembly: nunit.framework. Includes all 415 C# files under src/NUnitFramework/framework and the two handwritten assembly-information files linked by Directory.Build.props.

Excludes NUnitLite, NUnitLite runner, framework tests, NUnitLite tests, slow tests, mock assembly, testdata, build scripts, documentation, and all non-C# inputs. There are no generated C# exclusions in the selected core and no extra generated-code rules.

PairwiseStrategy.cs credits Bob Jenkins jenny and FleaRand algorithms. Retained as the integrated NUnit C# implementation with NUnit copyright, not a separately vendored dependency. Algorithm adaptation is a scope ambiguity, not proof of human-only authorship. No separately vendored production library was identified in the selected directory.
conditional_compilation: Historical targets are net35, net40, net45, netstandard1.4, and netstandard2.0. Directory.Build.props supplies PARALLEL, SERIALIZATION, TASK_PARALLEL_LIBRARY_API, THREAD_ABORT, PLATFORM_DETECTION, and APARTMENT_STATE conditionally. None of these or the target-framework constants enter this measurement.

The no-defines parse is not any historical target. The audit finds 5,926 nonblank lines in disabled preprocessor text across 82 files. These include comments and are not SLOC. Entire parallel, platform, and task adapters can disappear without disappearing from the input manifest.

Two assembly metadata #error directives remain active because no target is selected. FrameworkController.cs:369 references OSPlatform while Internal/OSPlatform.cs:24 disables its declaration without PLATFORM_DETECTION. AwaitAdapter.cs:56 references TaskAwaitAdapter while Internal/TaskAwaitAdapter.cs:24 disables its declaration without TASK_PARALLEL_LIBRARY_API.
comparability: Only four compiler errors remain: two CS1029 preprocessor #error diagnostics and two CS0103 unavailable-name diagnostics. No duplicate-definition diagnostics appear. The separate parser audit finds no other syntax errors.

Small binding-error count does not establish historical build fidelity. Missing target constants suppress large, real parts of NUnit. These figures describe the same source-only policy as Tertius, not NUnit binary semantics.

ConstraintExpression supplies 1,326 of 2,917 possible method pairs (45.4577%). EventListenerTextWriter supplies 595 of 836 shared pairs (71.1722%). The pooled ratio is sensitive to these two API shapes, not a typical-type score.

representative_types.name: NUnit.Framework.Constraints.ConstraintExpression
representative_types.interpretation: Low direct TCC does not establish incoherence. All 52 eligible methods concern constraint construction, but only five touch builder directly. Other methods use Append, which the metric does not follow. Properties are excluded from eligible method pairs. Depth 1 also reflects the broad fluent API.

representative_types.name: NUnit.Framework.Internal.Execution.EventListenerTextWriter
representative_types.interpretation: All 35 eligible methods share _defaultWriter. This is a coherent output adapter, but repeated overloads and a common forwarding target explain the maximum TCC. Maximum TCC does not prove extensive hidden implementation.

representative_types.name: NUnit.Framework.Internal.PropertyBag
representative_types.interpretation: Six eligible methods produce 15 possible pairs. Four directly use the inner dictionary and produce six shared pairs. Remaining behavior reaches it through an indexer or another method. Direct TCC 0.4 is consistent with one storage responsibility, not evidence for splitting the type.

representative_types.name: NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.NUnitTestCaseBuilder
representative_types.interpretation: WMC 47 behind two API entries supports hidden implementation, but private CheckTestMethodSignature alone contributes CC 35. High depth also reflects concentrated branching, so it is not automatic evidence of good design.

representative_types.name: NUnit.Framework.Interfaces.IPropertyBag
representative_types.interpretation: Six declared API entries and no function bodies produce zero depth. An interface contract is expected to expose operations without implementation. Its TCC is not applicable, not zero cohesion.

representative_types.name: NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.PairwiseStrategy.PairwiseTestCaseGenerator
representative_types.interpretation: WMC 44 behind one API entry is the project maximum applicable depth. Private generation routines hide combinatorial state. Its parent file credits an external algorithm, retained under the scope policy. One eligible method means TCC is not applicable.

syntaxAudit.parser: Tertius.Slop.Codebase.Under and SourceFile.Parse from the already-built counter
